hero.eyebrow: Backing tracks • Fretboard tools • Song analysis
hero.title: Tracks Hub
hero.tagline: Capture the Feeling. Compose the Meaning.
hero.description: Original practice tracks and focused tools for musicians who want to listen, understand harmony, map the fretboard, and create with purpose.

extra.02: Browse tracks by key, then sort newest or oldest first.
extra.04: Compare formulas, notes, root strings, and compact guitar shapes.
extra.06: Map scales across 15- or 22-fret necks and download a labeled PNG.
extra.08: Upload audio or paste a YouTube link to inspect the likely tonal center.
extra.10: Choose a key and explore common progressions for writing.
extra.12: Answer random string-and-fret questions to build note-name fluency.
extra.14: The newest release: a C major guitar track for spacious chords, melodic movement, and a reflective roaming mood.
extra.18: Designed by a guitarist for musicians who learn by listening.
extra.19: Jam Tracks Hub is designed and built by Jasper, a guitarist and music creator who turns weekly backing tracks into a focused workspace for practice, harmony, and songwriting ideas.
extra.20: Every page is shaped around real musician workflows: finding a key, mapping a scale, comparing chord colors, locating notes on the fretboard, and bringing the idea back to the instrument.
extra.21: The design goal is calm, practical, and musical: less menu hunting, more immediate sound, clear theory, and visual cues that support your ear without getting in the way.
extra.24: Send a note anytime. I usually use these messages to plan new backing tracks, workflow improvements, and guitar-focused tools.
extra.27: Get a note when a new backing track is released.

privacy.title: Jam Tracks Hub Privacy & User Content

body.02: Jam Tracks Hub Song Key Finder estimates the musical key of an audio file or a YouTube video selected by the user.
body.04: When you choose an audio file, the extension sends that file to https://jamtrackshub.com for musical-key analysis. When you submit a YouTube link, the extension sends that URL to the same service so its audio can be retrieved and analyzed.
body.05: The extension may read the URL of the currently active browser tab only when you open the extension, so it can prefill the form when that tab is a YouTube video.
body.07: Uploaded and downloaded audio is stored temporarily while the analysis job runs and is deleted when processing finishes. The service may retain the submitted YouTube URL and analysis result in operational analysis history for reliability and troubleshooting.
body.08: Recent results and interface preferences are stored locally in your browser. You can clear recent results from the extension.
body.09: If you join the email list, your email address is stored so Jam Tracks Hub can send updates about new backing tracks and related site news. You may request removal by contacting the site owner.
body.11: Data is used only to provide musical-key analysis, maintain service reliability, send requested email updates, and troubleshoot failures. It is not sold, used for advertising, or used to determine creditworthiness.
body.13: Data is processed by the hosting and infrastructure providers required to operate the analysis service. Reasonable technical measures are used to protect data in transit and during temporary processing.
body.15: You may use file upload or YouTube analysis only when you choose to do so. You can clear locally stored analysis history at any time or uninstall the extension to remove its local data.
body.17: For privacy questions, contact the developer through the support contact shown on the Chrome Web Store listing.
body.19: Song Workspace processes song titles, lyrics, chords, ChordPro text, and Jam Tracks Hub Song Documents locally in your browser. This song content is not uploaded to Jam Tracks Hub.
body.20: Song Workspace does not provide cloud song storage or browser-to-browser synchronization. Clearing browser or site data may remove locally stored songs, so use Backup All or export files when you need a portable copy.
body.21: Exported files may contain lyrics or other content you entered. Use or share them only where you have the necessary rights or legal permission.
body.23: Jam Tracks Hub provides tools for users to work with content they provide. Song Workspace is not intended to create a Jam Tracks Hub-hosted lyrics library.
body.24: Users are responsible for ensuring they have the rights or legal permission necessary for content they import, use, export, or share.
body.25: Whether a particular use is permitted depends on the content and applicable law; local processing alone does not make a use lawful.

legal.title: Legal & Usage Policy
legal.intro: These guidelines explain the intended use of Jam Tracks Hub tools and the responsibilities that come with content you provide.
legal.termsCopy: Use Jam Tracks Hub lawfully and in a way that does not interfere with the site, its services, or other people. Features may change, be limited, or become unavailable as the project evolves.
legal.workspaceCopy: Song Workspace processes song titles, artists, lyrics, section names, chords, anchors, ChordPro text, and Jam Tracks Hub JSON locally in your browser. This song content is not uploaded to Jam Tracks Hub.
legal.storageCopy: Song Workspace does not provide cloud backup or browser-to-browser synchronization. Clearing browser or site data may remove locally stored songs; use Backup All or export when you need a portable copy.
legal.copyrightCopy: Jam Tracks Hub provides tools for working with content you provide; it is not intended to create a Jam Tracks Hub-hosted public song or lyrics library. Only import or use content when you have the necessary rights or legal permission.
legal.lawCopy: Local processing does not automatically make a use lawful. Whether a particular use is allowed depends on the content, your permissions, and applicable law.
legal.exportCopy: JSON, ChordPro, TXT, Print, or PDF exports may preserve lyrics and other content you entered. Before using, redistributing, or sharing an export, make sure you have the rights or legal permission required for that action.
legal.privacyCopy: The local-first Song Workspace boundary does not mean the entire website collects no data. Other features, including Key Finder, may use network services, and the site may use limited operational analytics and hosting infrastructure.
legal.disclaimerCopy: Music-theory suggestions, transpositions, chord and capo results, and key analysis are provided as practical aids. Results may not be complete, error-free, or available at all times; use your judgment and verify important work.

description.major: The basic major triad: stable, open, and resolved.
description.minor: The basic minor triad: darker, inward, and emotional.
description.maj7: A bright major sound with a soft, floating seventh.
description.m7: A minor sound with a smooth, jazzy seventh.
description.7: A bluesy dominant color that wants to resolve.
description.m7b5: A tense minor seventh flat five color for jazz and leading motion.
description.sus4: A suspended sound that replaces the third with the fourth.
description.sus2: A suspended sound that replaces the third with the second.

major.name: Major
major.description: A clear seven-note foundation for harmony, melody, and major-key improvisation.

naturalMinor.name: Natural Minor
naturalMinor.description: A darker seven-note sound with a minor third, minor sixth, and minor seventh.

majorPentatonic.name: Major Pentatonic
majorPentatonic.description: An open, melodic five-note sound common in pop, country, soul, and uplifting solos.

minorPentatonic.name: Minor Pentatonic
minorPentatonic.description: A focused five-note sound used throughout rock, blues, and modern guitar playing.

blues.name: Blues
blues.description: Minor pentatonic with the expressive flat fifth added for tension and blues phrasing.

dorian.name: Dorian
dorian.description: A minor mode with a natural sixth, balancing a moody center with a brighter lift.

mixolydian.name: Mixolydian
mixolydian.description: A major sound with a flat seventh, ideal for rock, funk, blues, and dominant chords.

harmonicMinor.name: Harmonic Minor
harmonicMinor.description: A dramatic minor scale with a raised seventh that strongly pulls back to the root.
